messages:
jin: dropped an updated prototype for the eval diff toolbar and legend — main asks: keyboard order, compact toggle labeling, and non-color indicators so colorblind folks can parse quickly. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123
sasha: saw it. initial thought: compact toggle label 'Compact' is ambiguous. maybe 'Compact layout' or 'Dense/Compact' with a tooltip that explains what changes (spacing, metadata visibility).
emily: +1 on better label. also the toggle icon doesn't announce state with a screen reader. add aria-pressed and an accessible name like "Toggle compact layout (hides timestamps and metadata)".
raj: keyboard tab order is odd — after opening a diff the focus jumps into the action menu instead of the diff content. recommend: focus trap should land on the first interactive control in the toolbar, then go into the diff body. That reduces confusion for users who come in to scan results.
jin: noted. we prototyped focus-first-in-toolbar to match other consoles, will update.
tereza: legend: current version uses red/orange/green only. we should add small pictograms (check/x/wavy) and an optional pattern overlay for the swatch. also make the legend items keyboard-focusable and expose title attributes.
sasha: can we also show a textual state nearby when hovering or focusing, e.g., 'Pass (100%)' so it's discoverable without relying on color.
emily: microcopy tweak: the help popover currently reads "Compact removes noise" 12; suggest "Compact layout hides secondary details (timestamps, user IDs) for faster review. Toggle to see full context." clearer and actionable.
ci-bot: visual-check: snapshot mismatch for file eval_diff_toolbar_v4.png. Changed: toolbar spacing, toggle icon, and legend size. See /ci/artifacts/eval_diff_toolbar_v4.png
raj: spacing bump likely intentional for hit targets. Does this flip snapshots for multiple flows?
jin: it impacts a few snapshots. happy to revert spacing for the stable baseline and ship spacing increase behind an experimental flag.
sasha: accessibility trade: larger targets are better, but power reviewers want density. what if default is accessible spacing and a per-user 'compact density' preference reduces spacing? provide a progressive disclosure in settings.
tereza: and add a live announcement when an eval rerun finishes: a concise status update read by SR like "Eval run updated: 2 failures, 5 passes". use role=status and keep it under 5 words plus counts.
emily: small interaction ask: make the review-count badge clickable to filter the list to only failing tests, rather than showing a tooltip. People expect that. Also keyboard should support enter/space to activate.
jin: agree, we'll make it interactive. Plan: 1) rename toggle to 'Compact layout' + improved tooltip, 2) add aria-pressed and aria-label, 3) make legend icons + pattern overlays + keyboard targets, 4) move focus start to toolbar, 5) hide spacing change from baseline snapshots (flag it), 6) make review count actionable, 7) add live-region announcement. I'll update the figma and post new frame by EOD.
raj: sounds good. can we add a short note in the PR that calls out the accessibility fixes so reviewers can prioritize the merge?
jin: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: note: snapshot update queued for PR #4478.
